استنطقوا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْطَقُوا (istanṭaqū) /is.tan.tˤa.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
# اُسْتُنْطِقُوا (ustunṭiqū) /us.tun.tˤi.quː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
# اِسْتَنْطِقُوا (istanṭiqū) /is.tan.tˤi.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
